'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male student being scolded for his [[Flora Reindeer]] by an Academy Staff outside of the Academy.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Leonhardt:''' I don't care! This mech reindeer followed you back, so you're responsible!
:'''Finch:''' Look, even Exoswarm need proper nutrition to grow! Once they're mature, they can return to repair the Exostrider...
:'''Leonhardt:''' If it keeps eating the lawn, the bill's coming out of your stipend!
:'''Finch:''' Come on, Gnawee, be good. Let's go back to Bjartr Woods, okay?
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:'''Leonhardt:''' Great. Just great. The Exostrider's repaired, it's flown off, and your INSUFFERABLE mech reindeer are STILL nibbling on the Academy's landscaping!
:'''Finch:''' W-well... doesn't that prove the plants you grew are special? Richer. More nutritious...?
:'''Leonhardt:''' Does "nutritious" mean "eat as much as you like"?! Your reindeer ate half of everything we've PAINSTAKINGLY grown! Now I'm supposed to thank them for their taste?
:'''Finch:''' Um... Um... Maybe you could try a bite yourself?
{{Dialogue End}}
